```{r}
# Download R packages
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(sf)
library(viridisLite)
```

```{r}
#| label: data-management

# Ready-to-plot data: country borders + one disclosure category per dimension
dimensions <- c(campaign_expenditure = "Campaign expenditures",
                annual_accounts      = "Annual accounts",
                donations            = "Donations")

# Colours follow the category order; countries without data are light grey
type_colours <- c(viridis(8, option = "G", direction = -1, begin = 0.1), "#d9d9d9")

disclosure_map_data <- readRDS("disclosure_map_combined.rds") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(names(dimensions)), ~ fct_na_value_to_level(.x, "No data")),
         hover = paste0("<b>", name, "</b>",
                        "<br>Campaign expenditures: ", campaign_expenditure,
                        "<br>Annual accounts: ", annual_accounts,
                        "<br>Donations: ", donations))
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 12

# One map layer (a trace per country) for each dimension
add_dimension <- function(p, dimension) {
  map_data_dim <- disclosure_map_data %>%
    mutate(category = .data[[dimension]],
           fill = type_colours[as.numeric(category)])
  add_sf(p, data = map_data_dim,
         color = ~I(fill),
         split = ~paste(as.numeric(category), name), # keeps traces (and legend) in category order
         name = ~as.character(category),
         legendgroup = ~as.numeric(category),
         text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", hoveron = "fills",
         alpha = 0.92, line = list(color = "white", width = 1), # white borders between countries
         visible = dimension == names(dimensions)[1])
}

disclosure_map <- reduce(names(dimensions), add_dimension, .init = plot_ly(height = 650))

# Show each category only once in the legend, separately for each dimension
n_countries <- nrow(disclosure_map_data)
trace_names <- map_chr(plotly_build(disclosure_map)$x$data, ~ as.character(.x$name))
repeated <- unlist(map(seq_along(dimensions), function(i) {
  rows <- (i - 1) * n_countries + seq_len(n_countries)
  rows[duplicated(trace_names[rows])]
}))
disclosure_map <- style(disclosure_map, showlegend = FALSE, traces = repeated)

# Dropdown: show only the traces of the chosen dimension
dropdown <- map(seq_along(dimensions), function(i) {
  visible <- rep(seq_along(dimensions) == i, each = n_countries)
  list(label = unname(dimensions[i]), method = "restyle", args = list(list(visible = visible)))
})

disclosure_map <- disclosure_map %>%
  layout(
    title = "",
    # view window on Europe only: nothing is cut, other territories are just out of view
    xaxis = list(range = c(-25, 52), visible = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(range = c(34, 72), visible = FALSE, scaleanchor = "x", scaleratio = 1.7),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "<b>Digital disclosure</b>"),
                  x = -0.04, y = 0.6, # over the empty Atlantic on the left
                  bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)"),
    updatemenus = list(list(type = "dropdown", buttons = dropdown,
                            x = 0.01, y = 0.98, xanchor = "left", yanchor = "top",
                            bgcolor = "white")),
    annotations = list(list(text = "<b>Show:</b>", x = -0.04, y = 0.99, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
                            xanchor = "left", yanchor = "top", showarrow = FALSE))
  )

# Use the height set in plot_ly() instead of the chunk figure size
disclosure_map$sizingPolicy$knitr$figure <- FALSE

disclosure_map
```

<br> Note: Own elaboration based on Wolfs, W. (2023). The State of Digital Disclosure of Political Finance in Europe: Technical Paper. International IDEA. The map shows the type of digital disclosure of campaign expenditure, annual accounts of political parties and donations available across European countries. Categories range from no information online to fully searchable databases. Use the dropdown to switch between the three dimensions, and hover over a country to see its category in all three.
